name: Rome
summary: Rome combines an incomparable historical heritage – the Colosseum, the Forum, the Vatican – with a cost of living notably lower than other major Western European capitals. The city offers a vibrant environment for digital nomads, with an expanding coworking scene in neighborhoods like Ostiense and Garbatella, plus a gastronomy and social life that make a stay worthwhile beyond work.
considerations: Internet below average 110 Mbps compared to an average of 176 Mbps
sourceTitle: Roma, Italia para nómadas digitales | Roavio
